name: Young and Teen Writers Workshop
what_you_do: Two-week summer workshops in the afternoon. You pick two creative writing classes: fiction, genre fiction, poetry, plays, or intro to creative writing. Your work can appear in a printed book.
who_can_apply: Students ages 9 to 19. The eligibility section of the page says 9 to 19, but its header says ages 9 to 14. Check the page to be sure.
deadline_text: 2026 workshops ran July 6-31, 2026. Deadline was June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply on the workshop website. The address is english.chass.ncsu.edu/youngwriters.
notes: Dates are last year's. Several sessions, check which one fits your age. Page is inconsistent on age range (header says 9 to 14, body says 9 to 19).
